verified: Google's own blog post and Ars Technica both state that separate toggles for model training and chat history are rolling out in the Gemini app, that training is an opt-out setting located under Activity (or via My Activity > Other activity > Gemini Apps Activity), and that the history setting retains an adjustable limit.
unconfirmed: the completion date or regional scope of the rollout, whether the same split applies to Google AI surfaces outside the Gemini app, and whether anything changes for conversations already collected — the sources describe only the new controls, not retroactive effects.

verified: Ars Technica 报道称，Google 正在推送把聊天记录与模型训练分开的 Gemini 设置，训练改为可主动关闭的选项，并给出了设置路径。
unconfirmed: 推送完成时间、覆盖的账户类型和地区范围，以及关闭训练后数据处理的全部细节；报道没有提供独立测试，也没有说明新控件是否已在所有用户处可见。

titles.en: Google separates Gemini chat history from AI training with an opt-out toggle
titles.zh: Google 让 Gemini 用户保留聊天记录并退出训练
